summary_en: High-contrast identity for a premium delicatessen — from logo to micro-grid tin labels.
summary_pt: Identidade de alto contraste para um delicatessen premium — do logo às etiquetas de lata com micro-grid.
challenge_en: Stand out in a crowded luxury food market while maintaining accessibility.
challenge_pt: Destacar-se num mercado de comida de luxo saturado mantendo acessibilidade.
approach_en: Bold black and white contrast, precise typography, micro-grid system for tin labels that works at small scale.
approach_pt: Contraste ousado em preto e branco, tipografia precisa, sistema de micro-grid para etiquetas que funciona em pequena escala.
outcome_en: Distinctive shelf presence with elegant, timeless packaging that communicates premium quality.
outcome_pt: Presença distintiva nas prateleiras com embalagem elegante e atemporal que comunica qualidade premium.
body_en:
## Brand Identity

O Caviar required a sophisticated visual language that would appeal to discerning customers while remaining approachable. The logo uses custom lettering with refined serifs and a monogram mark.

## Packaging System

The tin label system employs a micro-grid structure that allows for flexibility across different product sizes while maintaining visual consistency. High-contrast black and white ensures legibility and premium perception.

## Collateral

Business cards and brochures extend the system with subtle textures and premium paper stocks.
